title: A rotating black hole in a Hernquist dark matter halo: horizon geometry, thermodynamics, and quantum emission
summary: We investigate the geometrical, thermodynamic, and quantum emission properties of a rotating black hole immersed in a Hernquist dark matter halo. Starting from a static black hole spacetime surrounded by a Hernquist distribution, we construct its rotating counterpart through the noncomplexification formulation of the Newman-Janis algorithm and analyze the modifications induced by the independent halo parameters $ρ$ and $r_s$ and the rotation parameter $a$.
